name: Iris Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Iris Group Berhad 的公告主要涉及诉讼事项、公司治理变动以及一项关联方 SaaS 协议；没有公告显示各业务板块有产能扩张、新业务进入、缩减或出售。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比下降35.0%，净利润同比下降90.4%。
overview_en: In 2026, Iris Group Berhad's announcements mainly involved litigation matters, corporate governance changes, and a related-party SaaS agreement; no announcements indicated capacity expansion, new business entry, reduction, or divestment in any business segment. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue declined 35.0% year-on-year, and net profit declined 90.4% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及诉讼、公司治理变动及一项关联方 SaaS 协议，未提及具体业务板块的运营变化。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly involved litigation, corporate governance changes, and a related-party SaaS agreement, with no mention of operational changes in specific business segments.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 IRIS International Ventures Sdn Bhd 与 Port City BPO (Pvt) Ltd 签订 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) 协议，属关联方交易。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary IRIS International Ventures Sdn Bhd entered into a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) agreement with Port City BPO (Pvt) Ltd, a related party transaction.
